Page 208 Cont.
May 5th Miss Helen Costillo(continued) - Miss Nellie Welsh a much younger teacher whom she befriended when first starting to teach, came to her rescue and succeeded in inducing the old invalid to return to the sacraments. The old lady had always said her night prayers as in early child-hood - Miss W. enrolled her a number of times before go- ing in seek of her soul - both now over-joyed at results.
Mrs. Hoefley - 78 - Heart ....
Mrs. Sweeney - 65 - in Ford Hospital very ill - Heart, liver ... Fever 104.
8th Mrs. Mary Bretza - 70 - in Gen. Hospital, Milwaukee, Wis ... dying of complicated - multiple cancer - I hope, a saint of our own day. Mother of 14 children was staying with a daughter here in Detroit ... had goitre removed last October; at that time was given two hours to live; three years ago had kidney removed ..... Her husband - 80 - poisoned 20 yrs. ago - insane ever since at least a patient in same general hospital - just across street ... was able to visit her .... hav- ing Purgatory ..... That
Mable Marnell - 45 - lost Voice - going on for about a year - opera- tion feared necessary.
Page 209 May 9 Mrs. Minnie D. Ostima - 54 - Heart-trouble and gall-bladder - in very much pain ....
9 Bernard Holowicz - 23 - Extremely nerveous ... so much so that at times believed he is posessed.
Joan Mary - 14 - Very threatening tuomer of abdomen .... They promise to read "City of God" if decided improvement is seen inside of week . 12 Philip Calliea - 45 - stomach cancer - wife and five children ask for prayers for recovery ....
12 Richard C. Ireland - 32 - Enemia - Drs. Hopeless ... can do nothing ... were figuering on taking him to Ann Arbor Hosp ... Dr. Goldhamer sent word "Nothing can help in science". . . . May 15
15 Father here To-night .... Proposes to read "City of God" - Aug. 15 here to-night seemingly cured. - out of danger - parents happy. Deo Gr.
